title: fr.audio_in.monitor_start arguments
description: Routes this input to fr.audio_out port to_port on the same node (1.1, design audio-a2 D3). Dispatch never blocks: OK once fr_audio has the monitor. INVALID_ARGS: to_port is not an fr.audio_out instance, or its sample_hz differs from this input's. BUSY: this input already monitors, or streams at another rate; or the output plays, or another input monitors to it. Ends with monitor_ended.

volume.description: 0: the output's own volume; else this monitor's only (%; 0..100)
